Method of Attack: Deploying Chinese Chopper web shells on compromised Microsoft Exchange servers for persistence and data theft, enabling remote code execution (RCE) and lateral movement within victim networks
Attack Vector: Exploitation of yet-to-be-disclosed Microsoft Exchange zero-day vulnerabilities (ZDI-CAN-18333 and ZDI-CAN-18802) via specially crafted autodiscover/autodiscover.json requests
Indicators of Compromise: Requests with pattern 'powershell.*autodiscover\.json.*\@.*200' in IIS log files
Use of Chinese Chopper web shells
User agent string associated with Antsword web shell management tool
